questions.question_text: True or False: The mother and father's attitudes and behaviors toward their child is the key element that fosters the development of gender identity disorder (GID).
questions.explanation: That said, generally, a number of authors from varied theoretical persuasions have found that clinic referred boys have either neutral or encouraging parents.

options.text: Male and female youth who have very clear childhood onset of GID, which has persisted into adolescence. Almost all the youth in this group have a homosexual orientation (sexually attracted to members of their own birth sex)

Male and female youth who have very clear childhood onset of GID, which has persisted into adolescence. Almost all the youth in this group have a heterosexual orientation (sexually attracted to members of the opposite birth sex)

questions.question_text: True or False: The response rates of selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) in OCD are comparable, and clomipramine is superior by a significant margin.

questions.question_text: True or False: Placement in a long-term residential facility serves as one way to achieve permanency in children who were removed from their homes.
questions.explanation: Permanency planning and placement, as mandated by law, includes (i) family reunification; (ii) child adoption; and (iii) long-term placement with kin or nonrelative foster caregivers who are granted legal guardianship.

questions.question_text: Which of the following models of classification focuses on the total context of the individual person?
questions.explanation: The ideographic approach rejects simple labels of classification and may be theory driven.

questions.question_text: Regarding Tourette's syndrome (TS) and comorbid conditions, which of the following is TRUE?

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of policy?

options.text: Position statements from American Academy of Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
Governing rules of the American Psychiatric Association (APA)
Governmental procedures developed to guide provision of services

questions.explanation: All are examples of policy.

questions.question_text: True or False: In psychoanalytic thought, drive is a term that encompasses the mental representations of the instinctual forces.
questions.explanation: Id encompasses the mental representations of the instinctual forces, whereas drive is applied to a stimulus arising from within the individual that arouses the mind and incites mental activity.

questions.question_text: Logical operations are a crucial developmental stage because

options.text: They are necessary to mastering basic reading skills
They are necessary to mastering basic mathematics skills

questions.explanation: Logical operations are crucial in mastering basic reading and mathematics skills, and they are also necessary for conducting social interactions.

questions.question_text: Which of the following statements about stuttering is false?

options.text: People who stutter have been found to show laryngeal behavior different from that in normal speakers
The risk of stuttering among first-degree relatives is more than three times the population risk
Most cases of stuttering are due to learned behavior rather than due to a biological component

correct_answers.text: Most cases of stuttering are due to learned behavior rather than due to a biological component
